headline: Beeline owner considering opening or acquiring a bank in Uzbekistan
summary: VEON, the parent of Beeline Uzbekistan, is weighing whether to set up a bank from scratch or acquire an existing one in Uzbekistan. The company already runs the Beepul payment service and microlending in the country.
why: VEON is an international telecom group, and a move into banking would expand its fintech and financial services exposure in emerging markets.

impacts.name: VEON
impacts.why: A possible bank launch or acquisition would expand VEON's financial services business in Uzbekistan.
